fact: UNICEF's notes to editors on Zimbabwe, in a release dated 11 December 2024, state that in 2023 the country completed the national assessment of its civil registration and vital statistics system and developed a strategic action plan (2023-2027) as a framework for improving the system; the text does not say the plan is costed, and adds that UNICEF has helped computerise 18 civil registration sub-offices and 2 district offices.
title: Birth registration steadily increases worldwide, but 150 million children still ‘invisible’
